Scene frame where playback of the trimmed clip begins. The entire scaled, repeated layer must fit the declared scene timeline.
First retained frame in clip-local time. Omission uses the earliest key across the clip. This and sourceEnd trim the reusable animation before retiming and repetition.
Last retained frame in clip-local time. Omission uses the latest key across the clip. It must exceed sourceStart and lie inside the authored clip key range.
Playback duration multiplier: two plays at half speed, one half at double speed. Duration is (sourceEnd minus sourceStart) times scale times repeat.
Whole number of repetitions of the trimmed clip. Playback returns to the trim boundary at each loop and retains the final endpoint on the last loop.
Play each trimmed loop backwards. Retiming and repetition still use positive duration; the first evaluated source frame is sourceEnd.

Compose this layer over the accumulated reference pose and earlier layers: REPLACE interpolates, ADD adds, SUBTRACT subtracts, MULTIPLY interpolates toward multiplication. Quaternion-specific COMBINE is not admitted.
Peak layer weight from zero to one. Schemaxis creates an explicit native LINEAR influence curve so static weights and fades are both effective and independently checked.
Scene-frame duration for linearly increasing layer weight from zero to influence. Together with fadeOut it must fit the layer; this is lowered into editable strip influence keys.
Scene-frame duration for linearly decreasing layer weight from influence to zero at the final loop endpoint. Extrapolated playback retains the boundary influence.
NOTHING contributes only inside the layer; HOLD retains both first and last boundaries; HOLD_FORWARD retains only the final boundary. Fade boundary weight remains effective during a hold.

/properties/production/properties/assets.explanation: Select the native source scene to reuse as an owned editable collection asset. Other source scenes and unselected branches are not imported as visible geometry. This selector applies only to blend files.
/properties/production/properties/assets.defaultMeaning: An empty selector infers a scene only when the source contains exactly one; multiple scenes require an explicit name. Scene-less plain object libraries use their separate bounded object route.
pitfalls: Source render settings, world, active camera, passes and frame-rate policy remain consumer-owned; the source action frame indices are preserved.

/properties/production/properties/assets.explanation: Select the source scene view layer whose included collection hierarchy forms the asset carrier. Excluded direct branches are omitted while collection instances retain their own referenced collection hierarchy and sharing.
/properties/production/properties/assets.defaultMeaning: An empty selector infers a view layer only when the selected source scene contains exactly one; otherwise choose explicitly.
pitfalls: Material overrides, holdout, indirect-only and local viewport hiding require an explicit compositing or visibility conversion before reuse. Data-level object/collection visibility flags are retained.

/properties/production/properties/meshDa.explanation: Select a declared float or byte colour channel as the Mesh active colour. Omission chooses the first declared colour channel; scalar and vector scientific fields are not colour channels.

/properties/production/properties/meshDa.label: Render colour channel
/properties/production/properties/meshDa.explanation: Select a declared float or byte colour channel as the Mesh render colour. It can differ from the active editing/display channel; omission chooses the first declared colour channel.

/properties/render/properties/renderer.label: Rendering engine
/properties/render/properties/renderer.explanation: Choose path-traced Cycles, real-time EEVEE shading or technical Workbench presentation. Each engine exposes controls that actually affect its output.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Cycles path tracing
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose path-traced Cycles, real-time EEVEE shading or technical Workbench presentation. Each engine exposes controls that actually affect its output. This variant chooses Cycles path tracing.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Cycles path tracing
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Cycles path tracing for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: EEVEE real-time shading
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose path-traced Cycles, real-time EEVEE shading or technical Workbench presentation. Each engine exposes controls that actually affect its output. This variant chooses EEVEE real-time shading.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: EEVEE real-time shading
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose EEVEE real-time shading for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: EEVEE render samples
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Set EEVEE temporal render samples. The legacy top-level samples field controls Cycles only; geometry complexity and shader compilation still affect elapsed time.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Ray-tracing policy
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Enable EEVEE screen-space tracing for supported visible geometry, or disable the tracing pipeline. Screen-space information cannot replace missing off-screen geometry or baked probes.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Disabled
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Enable EEVEE screen-space tracing for supported visible geometry, or disable the tracing pipeline. Screen-space information cannot replace missing off-screen geometry or baked probes. This variant chooses Disabled.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Disabled
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Disabled for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Screen-space method
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Enable EEVEE screen-space tracing for supported visible geometry, or disable the tracing pipeline. Screen-space information cannot replace missing off-screen geometry or baked probes. This variant chooses Screen-space method.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Screen-space method
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Screen-space method for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Trace resolution
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose a full, half, quarter, eighth or sixteenth render resolution for the tracing approximation. Lower resolution reduces work but loses spatial detail.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Ray-tracing filtering
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Use raw traced results or explicitly select spatial, temporal and bilateral noise reduction. A filtered policy needs at least one enabled filter.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: No filtering
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Use raw traced results or explicitly select spatial, temporal and bilateral noise reduction. A filtered policy needs at least one enabled filter. This variant chooses No filtering.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: No filtering
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose No filtering for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Filtered tracing
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Use raw traced results or explicitly select spatial, temporal and bilateral noise reduction. A filtered policy needs at least one enabled filter. This variant chooses Filtered tracing.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Filtered tracing
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Filtered tracing for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Spatial reuse
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Reuse neighbouring pixel rays to reduce tracing noise, trading some spatial independence for smoother results.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Temporal reuse
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Accumulate traced information by reprojecting earlier samples. Moving geometry and disocclusions can limit reusable history.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Bilateral filtering
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Smooth traced radiance while retaining differences across geometric/image features. This may remove fine detail along with noise.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Tracing precision
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Control ray-marching precision for the selected approximation. Precision is independent of image size, tracing resolution and render sample count.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Surface thickness
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Approximate surface thickness in scene world units for screen-space intersection or GI occlusion. Choose it with the scene scale and thin-wall geometry in mind.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Backface tracing
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose single-sided tracing or allow hits on polygon backs with a controlled reuse of front-face radiance.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Single-sided tracing
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose single-sided tracing or allow hits on polygon backs with a controlled reuse of front-face radiance. This variant chooses Single-sided tracing.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Single-sided tracing
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Single-sided tracing for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Trace both sides
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose single-sided tracing or allow hits on polygon backs with a controlled reuse of front-face radiance. This variant chooses Trace both sides.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Trace both sides
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Trace both sides for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Backface radiance reuse
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Reuse this fraction of front-face illumination for the backface approximation. Zero suppresses that reuse; one uses the complete front-face illumination.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Fast GI approximation
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Approximate ambient occlusion or global illumination for surfaces above the roughness threshold. Ray tracing must be enabled; this is an approximation with resolution and sampling tradeoffs.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Disabled
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Approximate ambient occlusion or global illumination for surfaces above the roughness threshold. Ray tracing must be enabled; this is an approximation with resolution and sampling tradeoffs. This variant chooses Disabled.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Disabled
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Disabled for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Ambient occlusion approximation
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Approximate ambient occlusion or global illumination for surfaces above the roughness threshold. Ray tracing must be enabled; this is an approximation with resolution and sampling tradeoffs. This variant chooses Ambient occlusion approximation.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Ambient occlusion approximation
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Ambient occlusion approximation for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Approximation rays
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Set rays per fast-GI evaluation. More rays reduce directional sampling noise while increasing work.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Marching steps
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Set steps along each fast-GI ray. More steps sample intersections more finely at additional cost.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: GI roughness threshold
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Use fast GI for surfaces above this roughness. One would disable the approximation and is refused when fast GI is enabled.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: GI maximum distance
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Limit fast-GI ray travel in scene world units. Zero leaves the maximum unspecified; it does not mean zero-length rays.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Surface thickness
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Approximate surface thickness in scene world units for screen-space intersection or GI occlusion. Choose it with the scene scale and thin-wall geometry in mind.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: GI self-intersection bias
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Offset fast-GI intersection decisions to reduce self-occlusion. Excessive bias can erase nearby contact detail.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Shadow rays

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Shadow steps
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Control EEVEE steps along shadow rays. More steps improve the approximation at additional render cost.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Workbench technical shading
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose path-traced Cycles, real-time EEVEE shading or technical Workbench presentation. Each engine exposes controls that actually affect its output. This variant chooses Workbench technical shading.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Workbench technical shading

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Technical lighting

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Studio lighting
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Flat, a bundled Studio environment or a bundled MatCap. Workbench ignores scene lamps and shader node lighting. This variant chooses Studio lighting.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Studio lighting
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Studio lighting for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Bundled lighting preset
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose a named Studio environment or MatCap bundled with the supported Blender runtime. User replacements and custom preset paths are not silently substituted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: World-space Studio lighting
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Keep Studio lighting fixed in world space instead of following the view. This enables an explicit environment rotation.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Studio environment rotation
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Rotate world-space Studio lighting around its Z axis in radians. A nonzero rotation requires worldSpace true.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Studio specular highlights
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Include Studio-light specular highlights in technical shading. This option belongs to Studio presets with a specular pass, not the bundled MatCaps.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: MatCap lighting
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Flat, a bundled Studio environment or a bundled MatCap. Workbench ignores scene lamps and shader node lighting. This variant chooses MatCap lighting.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: MatCap lighting
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose MatCap lighting for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose a named Studio environment or MatCap bundled with the supported Blender runtime. User replacements and custom preset paths are not silently substituted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose material swatches, geometric Object colours, mesh colour attributes, native object-based random colours or one uniform RGB colour. These sources have distinct authored meanings.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Material display colours
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose material swatches, geometric Object colours, mesh colour attributes, native object-based random colours or one uniform RGB colour. These sources have distinct authored meanings. This variant chooses Material display colours.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Mesh colour attributes

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Mesh colour attributes
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Mesh colour attributes for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: One display colour
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose material swatches, geometric Object colours, mesh colour attributes, native object-based random colours or one uniform RGB colour. These sources have distinct authored meanings. This variant chooses One display colour.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: One display colour
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose One display colour for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Display RGB colour

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Edge antialiasing
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Workbench edge smoothing or disable it for direct pixel checks. More temporal samples reduce jagged edges at additional render cost.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Technical shadows
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Enable Workbench shadows with a declared direction and darkness, or disable them. This does not use scene lamp transforms or energy.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Disabled
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Enable Workbench shadows with a declared direction and darkness, or disable them. This does not use scene lamp transforms or energy. This variant chooses Disabled.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Disabled
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Disabled for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Enabled
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Enable Workbench shadows with a declared direction and darkness, or disable them. This does not use scene lamp transforms or energy. This variant chooses Enabled.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Enabled
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Enabled for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Shadow direction
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Specify a nonzero Workbench light direction. The planner normalizes it without changing its direction; this is independent of scene lamps.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Direction component
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: One X, Y or Z component of the nonzero shadow direction; the planner normalizes the complete direction vector.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Shadow darkness
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Set the Workbench shadow intensity. Zero removes darkening; one uses full shadow intensity.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Shadow position shift
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Adjust the Workbench shadow offset to control shadow placement and surface self-shadowing.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Shadow focus
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Adjust the Workbench shadow focus, controlling the transition between lit and shadowed surfaces.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: World-space ridge strength
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Emphasize convex features using world-space cavity shading when both cavity methods are enabled.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: World-space valley strength
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Emphasize concave features using world-space cavity shading when both cavity methods are enabled.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Screen-space ridge strength
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Emphasize convex features from screen-space curvature when both cavity methods are enabled.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Screen-space valley strength
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Emphasize concave features from screen-space curvature when both cavity methods are enabled.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Object outline
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Draw an explicit object outline colour or disable outlines. This is distinct from Freestyle and Grease Pencil line art.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Disabled
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Draw an explicit object outline colour or disable outlines. This is distinct from Freestyle and Grease Pencil line art. This variant chooses Disabled.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Disabled
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Disabled for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Enabled
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Draw an explicit object outline colour or disable outlines. This is distinct from Freestyle and Grease Pencil line art. This variant chooses Enabled.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Enabled
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Enabled for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Display RGB colour
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Set a scene-linear RGB colour for the single-colour or outline policy. The declared display transform still controls its PNG encoding.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: RGB component
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: One scene-linear red, green or blue component. The display view and exposure determine its encoded PNG value; it is independent of shader lighting.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Xray display
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Blend technical surfaces with a declared alpha to reveal overlapping geometry, or use opaque surface display.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Disabled
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Blend technical surfaces with a declared alpha to reveal overlapping geometry, or use opaque surface display. This variant chooses Disabled.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Disabled
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Disabled for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Enabled
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Blend technical surfaces with a declared alpha to reveal overlapping geometry, or use opaque surface display. This variant chooses Enabled.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Enabled
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Choose Enabled for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Xray opacity
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Set Workbench xray surface opacity between zero and one. This is independent of PNG film transparency and shader alpha.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Cull back-facing surfaces
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Hide back-facing polygons in Workbench. Use consistent winding for open shells; this does not close a mesh or repair normals.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: Display transform
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Control how scene-linear shading becomes the displayed PNG, independently of the rendering engine and texture input colour spaces.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: Display view
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Choose an explicit bundled view transform. Standard/sRGB supports direct colour-patch expectations; AgX, Neutral and ACES tone mapping change highlight appearance.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: AgX tone mapping
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Choose an explicit bundled view transform. Standard/sRGB supports direct colour-patch expectations; AgX, Neutral and ACES tone mapping change highlight appearance. This variant chooses AgX tone mapping.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: AgX tone mapping
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Choose AgX tone mapping for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: AgX contrast
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Choose a bundled AgX look, from its base appearance through low/high contrast and Punchy. Other view transforms do not accept an AgX look.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: Standard display
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Choose an explicit bundled view transform. Standard/sRGB supports direct colour-patch expectations; AgX, Neutral and ACES tone mapping change highlight appearance. This variant chooses Standard display.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: Standard display
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Choose Standard display for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: Khronos PBR Neutral
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Choose an explicit bundled view transform. Standard/sRGB supports direct colour-patch expectations; AgX, Neutral and ACES tone mapping change highlight appearance. This variant chooses Khronos PBR Neutral.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: Khronos PBR Neutral
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Choose Khronos PBR Neutral for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: ACES 1.3
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Choose an explicit bundled view transform. Standard/sRGB supports direct colour-patch expectations; AgX, Neutral and ACES tone mapping change highlight appearance. This variant chooses ACES 1.3.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: ACES 1.3
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Choose ACES 1.3 for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: ACES 2.0
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Choose an explicit bundled view transform. Standard/sRGB supports direct colour-patch expectations; AgX, Neutral and ACES tone mapping change highlight appearance. This variant chooses ACES 2.0.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: ACES 2.0
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Choose ACES 2.0 for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: Raw view
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Choose an explicit bundled view transform. Standard/sRGB supports direct colour-patch expectations; AgX, Neutral and ACES tone mapping change highlight appearance. This variant chooses Raw view.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: Raw view
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Choose Raw view for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: Exposure
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Adjust scene-linear brightness in photographic stops before the display transform. One additional stop doubles linear values.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: Display gamma
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Apply positive additional display gamma correction. Keep one for the normal view transform; this is not a texture colour-space declaration.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: White balance
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Enable illuminant temperature and tint compensation, or disable the additional white-balance transform.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: Disabled
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Enable illuminant temperature and tint compensation, or disable the additional white-balance transform. This variant chooses Disabled.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: Disabled
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Choose Disabled for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: Enabled
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Enable illuminant temperature and tint compensation, or disable the additional white-balance transform. This variant chooses Enabled.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: Enabled
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Choose Enabled for this typed policy; only its declared controls are accepted.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: Illuminant temperature
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Specify the illuminant white-point temperature in kelvin for the enabled white-balance transform.

/properties/render/properties/colourMana.label: White-balance tint
/properties/render/properties/colourMana.explanation: Adjust the illuminant white point along Blender's tint axis. Ten is the native default; this is independent of exposure and material RGB.

/properties/production/properties/images.label: Stored alpha
/properties/production/properties/images.explanation: Interpret the stored alpha representation: straight keeps RGB independent with alpha as a mask; premultiplied stores RGB times alpha; channelPacked keeps all channels independent, including RGB at zero alpha; ignore makes the image opaque. This is shared by preview and shader users of the image.
pitfalls: Do not choose premultiplied for ordinary unassociated RGB, or the decoded colours change.
Native Workbench transparency is display behaviour, not a general compositing model.

/properties/production/properties/materi.label: Display image
/properties/production/properties/materi.explanation: Choose an independent Workbench image preview or the material display swatch. This does not connect the image to the shader, and applies only to root material graphs. Cycles and EEVEE evaluate the authored shader graph.
/properties/production/properties/materi.defaultMeaning: Omitting displayTexture chooses none: the material swatch.
pitfalls: Workbench needs a usable active UV map to display the image.

/properties/production/properties/materi.label: Material swatch
/properties/production/properties/materi.explanation: Explicitly use the material viewportColour for Workbench texture shading, even if other image nodes exist in its shader graph.

/properties/production/properties/materi.label: Swatch source
/properties/production/properties/materi.explanation: Explicitly use the material viewportColour for Workbench texture shading, even if other image nodes exist in its shader graph.

/properties/production/properties/materi.label: Captured image
/properties/production/properties/materi.explanation: Choose one declared captured image for Workbench preview. Its image identity and active UV map determine the display; its shader connections remain independent.

/properties/production/properties/materi.label: Image source
/properties/production/properties/materi.explanation: Choose one declared captured image for Workbench preview. Its image identity and active UV map determine the display; its shader connections remain independent.

/properties/production/properties/materi.label: Declared image
/properties/production/properties/materi.explanation: Identity of an image declared in production.images. The preview points to that captured resource, independently of Image Texture nodes used by the shader. Workbench samples the active UV map.
pitfalls: A file path or unknown image identity is refused.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Image texture
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Display each material's selected displayTexture using the mesh's active UV map. With no selected image or usable UVs the qualified native release uses the material viewport swatch. Shader graphs and render UV selection remain independent.

/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.label: Texture colour source
/properties/render/properties/renderer/a.explanation: Display each material's selected displayTexture using the mesh's active UV map. With no selected image or usable UVs the qualified native release uses the material viewport swatch. Shader graphs and render UV selection remain independent.

Keep false for inclusive object/collection membership. Complement scopes are not qualified public variants, and scope inversion cannot bypass layer exclusions.

Explicit line colour and priority overlays on logical Material owners. Shared Materials affect all their users; these records are not a per-object palette, surface-shader edit or per-line-set override.
One Material-owner line overlay. Conflicting logical aliases to the same native owner refuse before assignment.
Logical Material resource receiving this owner-wide line colour and priority. Every user of a shared owner is affected; aliases to one native Material cannot carry conflicting overlays.
Linear RGBA channels from 0 to 1, interpreted before output colour management. Material-owner line colour used by materialLine styles; it does not change the surface shader.
One linear red, green, blue or alpha component from 0 to 1. Material-owner line colour used by materialLine styles; it does not change the surface shader.
Integer Material line priority from 0 to 32767. At a material boundary the higher-priority adjacent Material supplies materialLine colour; this does not change surface shading or object depth order.

/properties/production/properties/simula.explanation: Bake the declared rigid-body world or cloth consumers for stable saved results when frames are reopened in a different order. Declare at most 32 distinct cache IDs and consumers. Each cache covers the complete production timeline, within 1000 frames; production fps determines the time between frames. Scene ownership, runtime, constructor and source fingerprints come from trusted construction and cannot be authored here. Changed simulation inputs require fresh construction and baking; a saved cache manifest alone cannot authorize reuse.

One bake for an existing typed physics consumer in this production scene. Choose the consumer kind, logical cloth object when applicable, full timeline and storage together. Construction binds the declared physics, admitted dependencies and fixed Blender runtime. Editing geometry, physics parameters, gravity, fps, frame bounds or dependency bytes invalidates the old bake.

Unique portable cache identity: begin with a letter and use up to 63 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. It identifies this bake and its managed payloads; it is not a native object name, file path or source-authority token.

Select the actual existing physics consumer: rigidBody bakes the scene rigid-body world; cloth bakes one declared cloth object. This does not create physics or enable other simulation families. Qualified Blender 5.2.3 supports packed rigid-body caches and packed or disk cloth caches; rigid-body disk conversion is explicitly refused because its native storage setter crashes before baking.

Logical production object ID of the declared cloth mesh consumer. For rigidBody, leave this empty: the cache belongs to the owning scene world and covers its rigid bodies. Native scene names and arbitrary native object lookup are not authored selectors.

First inclusive baked frame, equal to production.frameStart. Together with frameEnd it must cover the entire production timeline within 1000 consecutive positive frames; partial cache intervals are refused. Production fps sets physical time per frame. Changing the range or fps requires a fresh bake.

Last inclusive baked frame, equal to production.frameEnd. The complete timeline must fit within 1000 consecutive positive frames so render, export and other timeline samples cannot silently use an unbaked interval. Changing the range or production fps invalidates the old bake.

packed retains the bake inside the saved scene; disk publishes managed cloth .bphys files beside that scene in blendcache_<visit basename>/. Keep those declared files with the scene. External paths and inherited external caches are refused. Verification compares disk bytes with an independently constructed fresh bake before opening the submitted scene; packed data also requires all-frame geometry and physics checks. Rigid-body disk mode is explicitly unsupported in the qualified runtime; use packed rigid-body storage.
